title: Overlap compatibility of the canonical counit sheet sum
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative condensed ring, $p:U\to X$ any scheme morphism, and $P$ any internal $\Lambda_X$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. On each finite weakly etale splitting chart of $p$ as defined in [lem-sfb-finite-etale-split-hom-descent], define a map $d_c:g^*p_*p^*P\to g^*P$ by summing exactly the counit/composition projections of [def-sfb-internal-finite-etale-trace-formula]. This family is compatible in the precise sense of [lem-sfb-finite-etale-split-hom-descent]: after any two weakly etale refinements $a,b$ with equal composite maps to $X$, the two conjugated sums agree. The statement does not assume that $p$ is finite, etale or surjective: it concerns only its given finite splitting charts, including empty splittings.

source.place: Local computation, first paragraph: finite etale splitting, sheet sums, and descent

proof.text: For either chart and any base refinement a, form the sections of the pullback from a followed by the original sheets. Prove directly by the universal property that the ambient square is cartesian. The universality of finite coproducts of schemes (Mathlib FinitaryPreExtensive.isUniversal_finiteCoproducts and IsUniversalColimit.nonempty_isColimit_of_pullbackCone_left) then proves that the refined sections still form a coproduct. Reindex Fin by ULift to apply finiteSectionCoproduct_local_permutation at each point of Z. Project its equalities from U times_X Z to U. This supplies an open neighbourhood and a bijection matching the refined sheet maps, with no finiteness or etaleness assumption on p.

Use the proved source-library upperStarComp_assoc coherence equation to identify a further inverse image of finiteEtaleTraceSheetComparison with the comparison for the composite sheet. Naturality of upperStarComp for an arbitrary morphism epsilon between p-pullbacks, followed by cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms, proves compatibility of the conjugated projection with arbitrary further pullback. Specialize epsilon to the actual counit. Additivity of upperStar and bilinearity of composition distribute this equation over the finite sum. An equality of the base maps is transported by exactly the eqToIso in Compatible. No identification of the counit with a separate local-coordinate projection is needed.

Choose the open neighbourhood and sheet bijection from step 1 at every point of Z. On each neighbourhood, apply step 2 and Fintype.sum_equiv; corresponding terms are equal because their actual composite sheet maps are equal and equality certificates are proof irrelevant. To descend equality of module maps, forget the action using the faithful Mod.forget and use profinitePointModuleForgetPullbackIso to turn equality of module pullbacks into equality of abelian inverse images. The source-library upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction and hom_ext_of_openImmersionRestriction identify these with open restrictions and detect equality on the open cover. This includes the empty cover of an empty Z and empty sheet lists.

proof_origin.place: Local computation, first paragraph; completed with universal finite coproducts, the proved module pullback coherence, and the source-library open-restriction hom extensionality theorem.

theorem finiteEtaleSheetSum_compatible
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X)
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)) :
    FiniteEtaleModuleChart.Compatible Λ
      ((lowerStar Λ p).obj ((upperStar Λ p).obj P)) P
      (finiteEtaleSheetSum Λ p P)
